title: Pointwise existence of normalized completed coefficient presentations
statement: For every scheme T, there exists a CoefficientPresentation l T E i identifying completed coefficients with native locally finite coefficients, under the same prime, field, algebra, finite-dimensionality, and NativeGeometry hypotheses.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; finite quotient realization and normalization at a fixed scheme

proof.text: Construct the inverse-limit identification from the finite quotient realizations of completed coefficients. The finite constant equations fix the map on constant sections, and the residue equations identify every finite quotient with the native locally finite coefficient quotient. Localize this identification and compose with the normalized rational inclusion into the native ring sheaf; the resulting data form a CoefficientPresentation.
